# From Lua

The same functions and methods as the other pages, as a script of the Lua extension calls them (see the [Lua](../../lua.md) chapter): a console function with `ts.call`, a method on an object `ts.object` found. Arguments and results are text. A script reaches only its own realm's: an entry marked server is not there for a client's Lua. The functions that run text or touch files are refused (the chapter lists them).
